subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: After the two persistence races are repaired, should OpenClaw permanently expose the new operator timeout key and generic synchronous command-queue timeout callback?
rationale: Correctness review can require safe session ordering, but accepting a durable config surface and shared queue API requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Accept both opt-in contracts
options.body: Keep the config key and queue callback after deterministic persistence-race and upgrade coverage is added.

options.title: Keep the lifecycle private
options.body: Implement the bound through existing context-engine timeout policy without a new generic queue callback or operator key.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want to own a configurable deferred-maintenance timeout.

recommendation.title: Accept both opt-in contracts
recommendation.body: Keep the config key and queue callback after deterministic persistence-race and upgrade coverage is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main provenance covers the central affected lifecycle, persistence, and queue modules.
